affected_boundaries: repository dependency resolution to copied skill runtime

observed_behavior: Copied obligation validation fails MODULE_NOT_FOUND for lossless-json outside the repository.
expected_behavior: Copied runtime inspection executes without repository dependencies or Node search overrides.
causal_mechanism: The generated portable runtime retained bare package imports but the installer only copies skill resources.

anti_pattern.structural_description: A deployable directory depends on an ancestor dependency directory excluded from its deployment boundary.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: Repository tests resolve the dependency from the repository node_modules, masking its absence after copying.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Every dependency needed by the portable installed runtime is included in that deployment boundary.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Generate one licensed upstream module in the skill scripts directory and rewrite generated package imports to relative references.

applicability_conditions: Skill resources are copied outside the source repository.
known_non_matches: Typed source tests inside the repository resolve the installed package successfully.
confirmation_evidence: Real disposable installer regression failed before repair and passed after repair with Node search overrides removed.
regression_proofs: tests/installed-obligations.integration.test.ts: installed obligation runtime works outside the repository without Node dependency search overrides
